_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-73 base rate on ±2+ point moves makes HOLD the only statistically defensible call — the analyst's on-chain divergence warnings and the narrative's bullish analog cancel out any directional edge, so we wait for the coil to resolve.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD forward while the narrative leans bullish on resolution; the split reflects macro-opticals vs. on-chain fundamentals telling different stories within the same pattern match.
next_move.confirmed_if: MVRV Z-score holds above 20 AND BTC funding rises above 0.01% with VIX compression below 14, confirming macro-liquidity-driven grind higher into Disbelief
next_move.invalidated_if: MVRV Z-score drops below 20 with accelerating exchange outflows AND funding flips negative, signaling capitulation into Panic despite surface-level Denial optics
